thought.text: Poetry validates the project (exit 0, only deprecation warnings). Now running `poetry install` in the background since GDAL 3.6.2 compiles from source and takes a while.

reasoning_content: Only deprecation warnings; poetry check passes (exit 0). Next, run `poetry install` in the background and poll it. GDAL 3.6.2 compilation from source could take 10–20 minutes on 8 cores. Let's use nohup to run it in the background with output to a log.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup python3 -m poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi > /tmp/poetry_install.log 2>&1 &
echo "started PID $!"
